HEALTHCARE / PROJECT BREAKDOWN

Right Nutritions

A new nutrition and supplements website needed to develop its organic search presence in a trust-sensitive category. The work combined evidence-supported content with an internal-linking structure connecting related content and products.

rightnutritions.comGoogle Search Console3-month comparison

IN THIS CASE STUDYThe starting pointThe approachResults & evidenceWhat changedThe takeaway
01 / THE CHALLENGE

The starting point.

The earlier comparison period has zero recorded clicks and impressions. That makes the objective establishing measurable visibility, rather than calculating percentage growth from a meaningful existing traffic base. The category also called for careful attention to the quality and support behind health-related content.

02 / THE APPROACH

What the work involved.

  1. Focus on evidence-supported content

    The published approach emphasized scientifically supported content and trust considerations. This meant treating the usefulness and support for the information as part of the optimization work, rather than relying only on keyword coverage.

  2. Build a hub-and-spoke structure

    Related content was organized around broader topics, with links connecting the hub and supporting pages. This approach created a more coherent structure for users exploring the subject.

  3. Connect relevant content and product pages

    Internal links connected related information with product pages. The intent was to help users and search engines discover relevant pages within the same subject area, without treating every article as a standalone destination.

03 / THE EVIDENCE

Before & after.

The original screenshots compare the last 3 months with the previous 3 months. Exact calendar dates are not shown. This comparison period is not a verified implementation duration.

04 / READING THE RESULT

What the numbers tell us.

The site established 434 clicks and 23.3K impressions in the later three-month period, with a 1.9% CTR. Average position was 7.6 across the recorded search appearances. These provide an initial measurable search baseline for subsequent optimization.

Measurement context

Percentage growth is not meaningful when the starting count is zero. The screenshot does not demonstrate an instant ranking timeline, prove that all keywords rank on page one, or establish sales performance.

05 / THE TAKEAWAY

What this project shows.

For a new website, first establish a measurable baseline. Evaluate the relevance of visibility and clicks before making broad claims about growth or commercial success.
